text:
Elena Martínez | Machine Learning Engineer | Tel Aviv, Israel | AdVerge (500+ employees)  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley (2023)  
Email: elena.martinez@adverge.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/elena-martinez | GitHub: github.com/elena-martinez  

As a Machine Learning Engineer at AdVerge, I focus on building scalable models to enhance ad targeting and campaign optimization. My work integrates machine learning, cloud infrastructure, and data pipelines to drive measurable improvements in ad performance. I collaborate closely with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to align technical solutions with business goals.  

In my role, I developed a recommendation system that increased click-through rates by 12% for high-value ad campaigns. This involved refining feature engineering pipelines, integrating real-time user behavior data, and deploying models via Docker containers on Google Cloud Platform. I also contributed to a project that reduced ad-serving latency by 20% through optimized API endpoints and distributed computing strategies. My work with PyTorch and TensorFlow enabled the creation of models that improved conversion rates by 8% in A/B tests.  

Prior to joining AdVerge full-time, I served as a Machine Learning Intern, where I designed a natural language processing pipeline to analyze ad copy sentiment. This project, built with scikit-learn and deployed on GCP, helped identify underperforming ad variations, leading to a 9% improvement in campaign ROI. Earlier, as a Data Analyst Intern, I built a dashboard using SQL and Python to track ad spend efficiency, uncovering opportunities to reallocate budgets that saved the team $150K annually.  

My technical expertise spans cloud platforms, machine learning frameworks, and DevOps tools. I regularly use Docker to containerize models, ensuring reproducibility across development and production environments. Google Cloud Platform is central to my workflow, supporting data storage, model deployment, and monitoring through Cloud Storage and Cloud Monitoring. For MLOps, I leverage MLflow to track experiments and Weights & Biases for logging metrics, though these tools are used primarily for collaboration rather than deep customization.  

I also have hands-on experience with REST API design, creating endpoints to expose model predictions and integrate with ad platforms. My work with NLP tools like spaCy and NLTK has enabled me to build text classification systems that improve ad relevance. While I have experience with both PyTorch and TensorFlow, I prioritize frameworks that align with project requirements, such as TensorFlow for production-grade deployment and PyTorch for rapid prototyping.  

Outside of work, I contribute to open-source projects focused on adtech and machine learning, and I regularly attend industry meetups to stay updated on emerging trends. I am committed to continuous learning and aim to grow as a technical leader in the adtech space.  

Skills: Docker (containerized model deployment on GCP), GCP (data storage, model serving), NLP (sentiment analysis for ad copy), PyTorch (prototype development), TensorFlow (production models), scikit-learn (baseline models), REST API (prediction endpoints), MLOps (MLflow for experiment tracking), Apache Airflow (lightweight workflow automation).
